description: This file contains functions for validating flow structures, including checks for empty flows, start nodes, disconnected nodes, cycles, and node validity within a flow-based system.

methods.name: validateFlow
methods.description: Validates the overall flow structure, checking for errors like missing start node, multiple start nodes, disconnected nodes, and cycles.

methods.name: detectCycle
methods.description: Detects if there is a cycle in the flow graph to prevent infinite loops.

methods.name: validateNode
methods.description: Validates individual nodes for required fields and inputs.
